chunks.text: OpenAI and Cisco just launched Shirudo for AI cyber defense. The open-source project uses AI agents and eBPF kernel-level defenses. The goal is to shield vulnerable infrastructure before permanent patches are deployed. Gulf Business reports it targets AI-driven cyberattacks and blocks Java4shell exploits. Jeetu Patel says security teams need tools matching the speed of AI threats. He calls for self-defending infrastructure that shields itself until patches roll out. Would your security team let AI agents guard your infrastructure?
